title: Organization
description: The Organization entity shall represent a legal entity, such as a farming business, a cooperative, a contracting business, an advisory service, a laboratory, a veterinary practice, a trading partner, a certification body or a public authority. Within a given deployment it is the top-level container for all other data; in a federated environment each participating organization maintains its own Organization root.

@type.description: The entity, in a JSON-LD representation.

id.description: Unique identifier of the record, its primary key. Generated by the client that creates the record, so that records created while offline do not collide (clauses 5.1 a) and 9).

registrationNumbers.description: Official identifiers of the organization, keyed by issuing scheme.

roleUris.description: Roles performed by the organization in the value chain.

addressId.description: Foreign key to the Address entity.

createdAt.description: Time at which the record was created, set by the system.

updatedAt.description: Time of the last change to the record, set by the system. The cursor of offline synchronization and the basis of per-attribute last-write-wins conflict resolution (clauses 5.1 b) and 9).

originType.description: How the record came into being. Set when the record is created and not modified afterwards (clause 5.1 l)).

createdByJobId.description: Processing run that created the record. The service responsible follows transitively from ProcessingJob.serviceId (clause 5.1 l)).

clientId.description: Application or interface client that created the record.

allOf.$comment: V04: createdByUserId is set where originType is USER.
V04: createdByJobId is set where originType is SERVICE.
